judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving an incomplete work-in-progress state including an untracked `.lore/dod.md` file and an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file. In `ToolRegistry`, dynamic function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas are compiled once at registration time rather than resolved per call and cached in a `WeakMap`, violating a core requirement. Furthermore, the candidate failed to emit warning logs on validation failure, missed the one-line JSDoc comment on `execute`, and omitted over half the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, which would also cause CI's changelog and lint checks to fail.
